name: Combobox
intent: Searchable select — pick from a long list with type-to-filter (and optional create).
when: Many options that benefit from filtering

chooseOver.because: Select for short static lists without search
Command is a command palette; Combobox is a form field

extracted: cva variants/sizes remain generated by the structural extractor

lineage.confidence: unset — projection round-trip verified; no held-out eval yet

props.name: popoverClassName
props.description: Class applied to the popover content. Overrides the default 200px width.

props.name: creatable
props.description: When true, typing a value not in the list offers a "Create …" action.

props.name: createLabel
props.description: Label for the create action; defaults to `Create "<input>"`.

props.name: filtering
props.type: `options` is displayed exactly as given, // so the server's result set is what the user sees. /** Called with the debounced search term. Supplying it switches the combobox to async mode. */ onSearch?: (term: string) => void

props.name: searchDebounce
props.description: Debounce applied before `onSearch` fires. Default 300 ms; `0` fires on every keystroke.

props.name: shouldFilter
props.description: Client-side filtering. Defaults to off in async mode, on otherwise — set it to override.

props.name: loading
props.description: Renders a spinner in the list. Also gates `onLoadMore`, so paging cannot stack requests.

props.name: loadingMessage
props.description: Shown in place of `emptyMessage` while `loading` and the list is empty.

props.name: hasMore
props.description: Set false once the server has no further pages; stops `onLoadMore` firing. Default true.

props.name: selectedOption
props.description: The selected option, for when it is not in the current page of `options` — an async list that has been searched or paged past the selection would otherwise show the raw value on the trigger.

props.name: open
modal
props.description: Makes the popover its own modal layer: it takes `pointer-events` from everything beneath and traps focus. Off by default. Inside a `Dialog` you should not need it — the popover already renders inside the dialog (see `container`) — so reach for it only for a popover that must sit above a non-Radix overlay of the host's own.

props.name: container
props.description: Where the popover is portalled. Defaults to the enclosing `DialogContent` when there is one and `document.body` otherwise, which is what keeps the list clickable inside a dialog (issue #294). Pass an element to override that, or `null` to force `document.body`.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child element, merging props and behavior.

usage: Use Combobox when you need to collect user input or allow users to make selections. This component provides a consistent interaction pattern that users will find familiar and accessible.

Combobox should be used within forms or interactive interfaces where user data collection is required. Ensure proper labeling and validation feedback for accessibility. Avoid using this component for read-only or display-only content.

anatomy.description: Combobox is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Use semantic props
bestPractices.description: Use the component's built-in props rather than className overrides.

bestPractices.title: Don't override core styles
bestPractices.description: Avoid using className to override the component's fundamental styling.

bestPractices.title: Provide accessible labels
bestPractices.description: Include proper ARIA labels for screen reader users.

bestPractices.title: Don't skip accessibility
bestPractices.description: Never omit accessibility attributes for interactive components.

bestPractices.title: Handle all states
bestPractices.description: Account for loading, error, empty, and success states.

bestPractices.title: Don't ignore edge cases
bestPractices.description: Avoid showing broken UI when data is missing or loading.
